name: smwpatches-super-koopa-sound-effect-when-spawning
title: Super Koopa Sound Effect When Spawning
description:
This patch adds a sound effect to super koopas when spawning similar to bullets so its easier to react to them especially in fast paced levels.

You can seperately edit the sound effect for the koopa that flies down and the one that jumps via the asm file.

v1.0
